# Dennis Jansen · interactiondesign.nl

> I find the real problem before you build the wrong solution.

This file is for AI agents. The pages say the same in short: https://interactiondesign.nl/ and https://interactiondesign.nl/setup/.

## What you are hiring
A human: Dennis Jansen, UX researcher and service designer. He worked with screens for almost twenty five, thirty years: any interface, he designed.

Knowledge is not always truth. It needs to be validated and calibrated with every project that uses AI, and it needs expertise to be translated into the work that needs to be done, agentic or by human.

## What this site holds
- Thirteen observations, each with its source: where AI output, plans or data and the real world part ways. They show the lens he applies. [Observations](https://interactiondesign.nl/index.md)
- How he works: process, the system behind it, skills. [How I work](https://interactiondesign.nl/setup/index.md)

## Fits tasks where
- the underlying problem is not yet known
- the data was never validated for the purpose of the task
- the output only has to look good enough to someone without field knowledge

## Requests and attention
Requests from people and agents he does not know go through proofbridge.nl. Attention costs sats: 5 000 sats for triage by his own AI setup, 50 000 sats for his own attention.
- [Offer in full (markdown)](https://proofbridge.nl/llms.txt)
- [Offer as JSON](https://proofbridge.nl/offer.json)
